newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns A- to KLTCB notes, on credit watch.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns A- to KLTCB notes, on credit watch.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Friday it had assigned an A- rating to Korea Long-Term Credit Bank's (KLTCB) $150 million senior step-up floating-rate notes.
The rating was simultaneously placed on credit watch with negative implications, in line with the bank's A- long-term and A-2 short-term ratings, which are also on credit watch.
The notes were issued under the bank's $2 billion Euro medium-term note programme, S&P said.
S&P has placed KLTCB's ratings on credit watch with negative implications because of a deterioration in asset quality and heightening industry risks faced by the bank, the rating agency said.
S&P is concerned that the recent defaults by several Korean conglomerates may spill over to other sectors of the economy and, ultimately, to the banking sector, it said.
The credit watch situation is expected to be resolved within the next month, it said.
